I have chalk, stickers, leaf blower, helmet, goggles, shield and colorful t-shirt. I am well-supplied and ready for a peaceful march. 
#BlackLivesMatter 
 Actually I have those things (not the cool shield) but others are more courageous than me. So thank you and be safe.

Really, the police are endorsing a racist who happens to also be a criminal. Cops think they have the power to be bullies, using force instead of negotiation. I think prisons foster these attitudes myself. This is what we are trying to heal. #BLM
I'm convinced now that in the second coming, Jesus will arrive as a black person. What better way to see into the hearts of others? #BLM
The police seem to be addicted to brutality. They do not like wearing diapers is my bet. #BLM
